sentences.en: The heat indicator on the oven showed that it was too hot.
sentences.zh: 烤箱里的温度指示器显示温度太高了。

sentences.en: Check the heat indicator before you start cooking to avoid burns.
sentences.zh: 在开始烹饪前检查一下温度指示器，以免烫伤。

sentences.en: The car's heat indicator light came on when the engine was overheating.
sentences.zh: 当发动机过热时，车上的温度指示灯亮了起来。
